title: Deck content
description: Semantic slide content. Contains NO coordinates, colours, fonts or sizes — the theme and renderer own all of that. If you find yourself wanting to specify a position, the slide type is wrong; pick a better one.

sections.description: Ordered section labels. Slides reference these by index for the numbered eyebrow (01, 02...).

style.description: Style name; overrides the theme's defaults. Cross-cutting token variant applied on top of the theme.

cite.description: Provenance for a factual claim. Written by the research step.

standfirst.description: One-line deck under the headline — two lines of subhead is all the header band has before the body

presenter.description: Who presents this slide. Free text; the chrome footer shows it instead of the deck's presenting member.

notes.description: Speaker notes; never rendered on the slide

speaker_note.description: A note rendered on the slide itself, in a thin bar above the chrome footer. For speaker instructions the audience may read. Only drawn on standard content-box slides.

image.description: Path relative to the deck folder

value.description: A number for this stage (e.g. "30%"). The funnel's taper is drawn from these only when EVERY stage carries one; a stage without a value makes the whole funnel render as equal-width steps, because a partial taper would fake the stages it cannot measure.

sentiment.description: Qualitative stage colouring, optional. The layout draws no vertical position from it — without real values the journey renders on a flat rail.

value.description: A real measurement for this stage. The journey draws a true line only when EVERY stage carries a value; a single missing value falls back to the illustrative flat rail, because a partial line would fake the stages it cannot measure.

text.description: The row's value. A single string for a two-column table, or an array of strings (one per column) for a multi-column one.

html.description: Freeform slide body: arbitrary HTML/CSS rendered full-bleed by headless Chrome. The slide rasterises — text is not editable in PowerPoint afterwards. Sandboxed: no scripts, no network, no external resources, inline styles only. The institutional chrome (crest, footer, slide number) overlays the render, so leave safe margins.

bs.description: A branching-flow step. Title only: the type's centre is its decision, and a body under every step takes the column the decision needs to grow into — measured, the two cannot coexist above the readable floor.
